target_pattern: Choose preterite for completed events and imperfect for background, habitual, and ongoing context, including verbs whose meaning shifts by tense.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one past form for every situation and translating was, knew, could directly.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish separates completed story events from background context, and several high-frequency verbs shift meaning depending on preterite vs imperfect.
target_pattern_formula: background, habit, and ongoing state use imperfect
interruption pattern: imperfect plus cuando plus preterite
meaning shifts: conoci and conocia, supe and sabia, quise and queria, pude and podia, tuve and tenia
natural_examples: Cuando era nino, iba a la playa cada verano.
Estabamos en el parque cuando empezo a llover.
Conoci a Juan en 2010, pero Maria ya lo conocia.
Yo podia trabajar el sabado, pero no pude ir.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Era nino cuando viviamos en Lima. -> change subject to nosotros for first clause.
Base: Lei un libro ayer. -> change object to plural dos articulos.
Base: Cocinabas cuando sono el telefono. -> change pronoun to yo.
Base: Estabamos en el parque cuando empezo a llover. -> change location to la playa.
Base: Juan estaba en el ejercito cuando conocio a Maria. -> change conocio to imperfect meaning.
Base: Queria salir, pero no podia. -> change second verb to successful preterite result.
Base: Llegue a la reunion y todos hablaban. -> change first verb to llegaste.
Base: Mi papa fumaba todos los dias. -> make it negative habitual.
Base: Visitamos a nuestros abuelos el domingo pasado. -> change subject to ellas.
Base: Hablaba con su amigo cuando escucho un ruido. -> change subject to nosotros first verb.
Base: No sabia que querias ir. -> change sabia to preterite find-out meaning.
Base: Conoci a Laura en 2020. -> change to imperfect know meaning.
Base: Pude terminar el informe. -> change to imperfect capability only.
Base: Tuve la impresion de que no queria venir. -> change tuve to imperfect.
Base: Hacia frio y el cielo parecia gris. -> add completed interruption with entonces.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the correct option for the intended meaning.
prompts: I met Juan in 2010. (Conoci a Juan en 2010. vs Conocia a Juan en 2010.)
I knew Juan. (Conocia a Juan. vs Conoci a Juan.)
When did you find out? (Cuando supiste? vs Cuando sabias?)
I did not know you wanted to go. (No sabia que querias ir. vs No supe que querias ir. for ongoing ignorance)
I managed to finish. (Pude terminar. vs Podia terminar.)
I was able to work Saturdays in general. (Podia trabajar los sabados. vs Pude trabajar los sabados.)
I got the impression. (Tuve la impresion. vs Tenia la impresion. for a specific moment)
I had the impression. (Tenia la impresion. vs Tuve la impresion. for ongoing state)
I wanted to scream at that moment. (Quise gritar. vs Queria gritar.)
I refused to tell him. (No quise decirle. vs No queria decirle.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that when you were a child, you used to visit your grandparents on Sundays.
Write that yesterday you finished an important report.
Write that while you were driving, someone called you.
Write that you were at work when the internet went down.
Write that you did not know your client wanted to reschedule.
Write that you found out the meeting changed.
Write that you met your business partner in 2018.
Write that you already knew that person.
Write that you wanted to call, but you could not.
Write that you managed to solve the problem yesterday.
Write that there was heavy traffic when you left home.
Write that it was raining and people were running.
Write that your colleague told you he could work Saturday.
Write that you got the impression they were not interested.
Write that you had that impression for weeks.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Habitual meaning is not identified as ongoing pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use imperfect, for example fumaba todos los dias.

common_errors.mistake: Using imperfect for one finished event
common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct translation from English simple past.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use preterite for completed event, for example fui a la tienda ayer.

common_errors.why_it_happens: State meaning confused with discovery event.

common_errors.mistake: Podia when meaning managed to do it
common_errors.why_it_happens: Capability and successful completion are mixed.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use pude for completed successful action.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Literal transfer of did not want.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use no quise for refusal in a concrete moment.
Use imperfect for setting: hacia frio, parecia.
Use imperfect for ongoing action and preterite for interruption.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Nuance of specific moment vs ongoing state ignored.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use tuve la impresion for single moment, tenia for ongoing state.

common_errors.mistake: No time anchors in narrative practice
common_errors.why_it_happens: Context cues for tense choice are missing.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Add markers like ayer, anoche, cuando, mientras.
